entries.runtimeBoundary: Topology participates only in a fresh project-specific AVR Build; this contract grants no independent runtime authority.
entries.expectedBehavior: Only endpoints in the declared branched net are joined; the other route at the same drawing point remains a separate net.
limitations: A junction is authored graph topology, not a decorative or physical component.
Only endpoints in the declared branched net are electrically joined; a different net crossing at the same drawing point remains separate.
The contract does not model contact resistance, current capacity, voltage drop, heating, parasitics, arcing, insulation, safety certification or physical hardware.
Opening or drawing a junction never restores or creates executable authority.
entries.provenance: Original project-owned graph contract, route data, canonical project data and example source.
